title: CMIP6 SSP245 climate-emulation audit
summary: Fit a physically unit-aware spatiotemporal emulator from a compact CMIP6-style training fixture and forecast a hidden SSP245 window plus a withheld perturbation.
taskPrompt: Read input/problem_spec.md and complete the deterministic climate-emulation workflow. Build the exact 11-term design matrix from the 108 training months, fit one least-squares emulator per variable and grid cell using training rows only, forecast the 12-month SSP245 test forcing, and write every required artifact under output/. Preserve K and mm/day units, the intermediate preprocessing archive, coefficient field, metadata hash, summary invariant, and ordered CSV. No internet; runtime 60 seconds and 512 MiB.
agentMustDo: load and validate the visible forcing/target fixture
construct the specified design matrix and intermediate artifact
fit training-only coefficients and forecast SSP245
write exact archives, metadata, summary, coefficient field, and CSV

inputFiles.name: climate_fixture.npz
inputFiles.description: Benchmark-authored compact CMIP6-style forcing and training target fixture

evaluation: Contract gates return 0 for missing, malformed, extra, nonfinite, wrong-unit, or wrong-shape outputs. Score weights: CSV 0.10; SSP245 tas RMSE 0.20; SSP245 precipitation RMSE 0.20; coefficient field 0.20; evaluator-only forcing perturbation 0.20; latitude-area weighted physical invariant 0.10. Full score requires all components.
